subject: Renewal acceleration & QBR scheduling
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@celerity.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-11-08T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Renewal acceleration & QBR scheduling

Hi Alex —

Thanks for the productive renewal signal last week. We heard you want to accelerate the renewal timeline and lock in the additional capacity for H1. To make sure legal/procurement and your engineering teams are aligned, proposing the following next steps: 

1) Quick pre-QBR sync (internal + procurement) — 30 min — week of Nov 13
2) Draft term amendment (outline term change + capacity uplift) — I’ve attached a first-pass PDF for review (Celerity_Renewal_Draft_v1.pdf).
3) Full QBR (30–45 min) with key stakeholders to confirm usage patterns and rollout dates — propose two windows below.

Possible QBR windows (Pacific):
- Tue Nov 14, 10:00–10:45 PT
- Wed Nov 15, 13:00–13:45 PT

Please confirm who from procurement/legal should be on the call (I cc'd contracts@celerity.ai for visibility). We also want to confirm the requested uplift: +2 dedicated GPU nodes (steady state), with a 30% burst allowance for traffic spikes — Ben, Monica and I have draft pricing and rollout notes.

If we can lock a pre-QBR this week, we’ll share an agenda and the HubSpot deal page so everyone can track action items.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
stephanie@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: Celerity_Renewal_Draft_v1.pdf
From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@celerity.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Hayes <jordan@acerohealth.com>, contracts@celerity.ai
Date: 2028-11-08T11:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal acceleration & QBR scheduling

Thanks Stephanie —

Appreciate the draft. We are supportive of accelerating and the +2 nodes sounds right given forecasted inference growth. A couple of asks from our side before the QBR: 
- Procurement needs a short summary of term changes (effective date, term length, cancellation/renewal windows). Can you include that in the draft?
- Legal wants T&Cs redlines turned around within 30 business days; they asked for the primary contact for review (please cc contracts@celerity.ai).

Jordan (our head of platform) will join the QBR — Jordan, looping you in to confirm availability for the suggested windows. If neither works, we can propose alternatives on Nov 16–17.

Quick note (forwarded):
On Wed, Nov 8, 2028 at 9:12 AM Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Hi Alex —
> 
> Thanks for the productive renewal signal last week...

Thanks,

alex.turner@celerity.ai

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-11-08T16:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal acceleration & QBR scheduling — internal prep

Stephanie / Monica —

Quick internal notes ahead of the pre-QBR: 
- Pricing options: 12-month term with committed capacity (recommended) vs 24-month with a 10% prepay credit. For Celerity’s usage profile the 12-month commit with a staged uplift (month 1: +2 nodes, month 3: +2 burst) preserves flexibility.
- Contract ask: we should offer an accelerated review path for redlines — propose 10 business days initial turnaround, then final T&Cs within 30 business days to satisfy their procurement request.
- Technical: Monica, can you draft a short operations note on provisioning lead time for +2 GPUs (estimated 7–10 days) and include KV-cache migration considerations?

I’ll put together two short pricing bullets to attach to the QBR agenda. Also adding HubSpot deal RDW-2784 to the meeting notes.

Ben Carter
Senior Account Manager, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.ai

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@celerity.ai>, Jordan Hayes <jordan@acerohealth.com>, contracts@celerity.ai
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-11-09T15:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal acceleration & QBR scheduling — proposed times & agenda

Hi all —

Thanks for the quick responses. Based on availability signals here are two confirmed options for the QBR (please pick one):
- Option A: Tue Nov 14, 10:00–10:45 PT (preferred)
- Option B: Wed Nov 15, 13:00–13:45 PT

Agenda (30–45 min):
- 5 min: goals and acceptance criteria for the renewal acceleration
- 10 min: capacity uplift & provisioning timeline (Monica)
- 10 min: commercial summary & term amendment highlights (Ben)
- 10 min: procurement/legal action items & next steps (Stephanie)

Attachments: QBR_Agenda_template.docx, Celerity_Renewal_Draft_v1.pdf
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/2784
DocuSign placeholder: https://www.docusign.com/placeholder/5682

Can contracts@celerity.ai confirm the turnaround expectations so we can include that in the meeting invite? Once we have a confirmed timeslot I’ll send a calendar invite with the agenda and brief pre-read.

Best,
